I think I'd better be going now.
Good. You had me worried.
HAHAHAHAHA!\255\003I'd almost think you were serious!
Yes, leave me to my ingenious plans.
You know, I'm working on a way to get rid of the humans once and for all!
Tell me more about this shrinking ray of yours.
So what are you plotting?
What are you ranting about?
Just exactly how WELL did you know Dr. Fred?
Are you the same Purple Tentacle who knew Dr. Fred?
If you'll excuse me, I've got something in the oven.
Look, I'm very busy with my ray gun, so please leave me alone.
I'm building a SHRINKING ray, which I can use to shrink those pesky humans out of my sight for good!
Up on your ancient history, are you?\255\003Yes, I remember that insignificant insect.
Anyone I know?\255\003Heh.
I call it the DIMINUATOR.\255\003The biggest problem left is to design a trigger that doesn't require FINGERS.
I don't need your paltry offerings.
He might clap me in irons if I do that.
That trick has got to be older than I am.
Don't torment me, I'm a powerful tentacle.\255\003I could have you served on a bed of rice.
'kay.
Meanwhile^
Tell me, Lieutenant, how do you REALLY feel about humans?

Honestly, sir?\255\003I think they're filthy.\255\003Obscene.\255\003Foul.\255\003Sickening.\255\003Like the stuff in your eyes when you wake up.\255\003Like the wax that builds up behind your suction cups after a few days.
Like^
That's enough, son.\255\003I just wanted to be sure you weren't one of those humanist sympathizers.\255\003What with this ridiculous `human show` going on here there's humophiles everywhere.
I'm no humophile, sir.
That's good.\255\003Now let me tell you about a little plan I have^
Lieutenant, I want to ask you something.\255\003It may trouble you.
Ask away, sir.\255\003I can take it.\255\003I've got a strong stomach.\255\003Nerves of steel.\255\003Bowels of brass.
Suckers of--
Can it, son, this is important.\255\003Have any of your friends seemed a bit^\255\003^FIRM, lately?
Ew, ick.\255\003You mean like, non-squishy and non-slimy?
That's right.\255\003Come closer.
I have recently become suspicious that HUMANS might try to infiltrate us.
Though basically stupid, they can be tricky.\255\003They may be in disguise^
Ahem.
Ah, Lieutenant, I'm glad you're here.\255\003What kept you?
Errr^\255\003Well, I hate to say it sir, but there was some trouble with one of the humans.
Trouble?\255\003What sort of trouble?
Nothing I couldn't handle, but I've noticed something about the humans that may pose a problem.
Do continue.
Well sir, in general they seem to be a bit^\255\003^LARGER than us tentacles.\255\003You know, taller.\255\003Heftier.\255\003More massive.
Able to leap--
I get the picture, son.
I don't mean to carry on, sir, it's just that it makes me feel^\255\003^inadequate.\255\003Small.\255\003Inferior.
Out of control of--

Before you go off the deep end there, let me tell you why I called you here.\255\003You see, I've invented something which will end our troubles with those glandular leg-walkers for good.\255\003I've invented^
^the Diminuator!
The what?
It's a SHRINKING ray, dolt.
Oh, I get it!
Now, I need you to get me a few parts so I can finish the thing.\255\003Come over here.
I got the frabomatic gizmo for you, sir^
You mean the high-frequency frabjistatic generator?
^yes, that one.\255\003But I'm having trouble locating the numo-whatsis.
The pneumo-electric de-amplifier.\255\003You might try that old abandoned lab in the basement.\255\003It's hardly been touched in two hundred years.
Yes, sir.
The Diminuator will be my crowning success!\255\003With it I will be able to shrink the entire human race out of sight!\255\003BWAHAHAHAHA!!
Well, errr, young tentacle^\255\003^what have you got to report?
I've found the piece you needed, sir.
Excellent!\255\003The human race shall soon be as puny as their intellects!
Have the prisoners been keeping intellects as pets again?\255\003I'll have to reprimand them!
That's INSECTS, you buffoon!\255\003Anyway, we have more important things to think about.
I once read that humans were descended from buffoons.
THAT'S--\255\003^never mind.  I need your help with another matter.\255\003Come closer, I'm about to reveal my MASTER PLAN!
It begins two hundred years in our past^
Well, errr, whatever your name is^\255\003^how goes our secret plan?
Just fine, sir.
Ah, excellent!\255\003Hahahahahaha!
I can't, my therapist and I have an agreement.
I better not, my scoutmaster warned me to be careful.
I don't wanna cut that, man.
scalpel
`The Chicago Manual of Thermodynamic Flux Induction Circuit Design`\255\003Great stuff!
'The Chicago Manual of Thermodynamic Flux Induction Circuit Design'\255\003I'll bet this'd work better than a sleeping pill.
textbook
can-opener
Yeeeheehee!
Bernard, float over here so I can punch you.
This must be that Woodstock place Mom and Dad are always talking about!
What could it all mean?
I don't know!\255\003I don't wanna know!
Hahahahahaha^
DIE! HAHAHA! DIE!^
We may not live to see yesterday!
I'm sure Doctor Fred wouldn't have done this if it weren't safe.
After all, he IS a doctor!
